Good Game. While definitely not on the same level as the original trilogy, this game still has some things going for it.
The only thing that bothered me the most was the fact that there are lots of loading screens just to get from one planet to another for a single 'talk to this npc' quests.
Story was pretty okay.
Hope the next Mass Effect will have some of the qualities of this game while still following a story connected to the OG trilogy
7/10

A great continuation of the Mass Effect franchise, set 600 years - and a whole new galaxy - away from the safety, security, and familiarity of the Milky Way. While fun, with its jet packs and "profile" switching, the game *can* feel strained at times. Its facial animations feel a bit uncanny sometimes, but the plot feels decent enough to warrant a sequel that will likely never happen.

I picked this up on deep discount and think the game has a bit of an unfair negative reputation.  Now, I am coming from a complete unbiased opinion in that I did not play any of the previous mass effect games, so I had no expectations coming in of how the game should go.  That being said I beat the game at just shy of 51 hours and had an enjoyable time doing it.  I thought the last battle was pretty epic and with a satisfying end.  Maybe I'll go play the other mass effect games now and be enlightened as to why I didn't have fun in this one, but as of right now I'd say the game is pretty fun for story-driven sci-fi RPG fans.

There were a couple of annoying bugs that came up.  The first there were a couple of missions I had to redo because you have to kill "all" of the bad guys to proceed and one of them would have spawned in a wall or under the floor or maybe ran off to go get ice cream or something but I couldn't find them.  The second was the game kept dropping to windowed mode for some reason. It was always at a transition such as looting a chest or a dialog beginning.  Neither were show stoppers and I got through just fine.

Otherwise I found the combat satisfying and fun.  I didn't try them all, but there looks to be a variety of play styles available. The number of missions in the game is pretty huge.  There's no lack of content.  I would have liked to be able to explore some of the planets that you can only scan.  That seemed like a miss on the part of a space game.  The planets you can explore, though, are plenty big and lots of content.

I'd give it a 7/10.  A solid game, but not amazing.  The game was obviously set up for a sequel, but I guess that will never see the light of day.  Pity, because I'd like to see what the dev team could do with a second effort in the same galaxy.

Definitely a solid buy on sale.

Mass Effect: Andromeda

Let's begin with the games biggest short comings.. the Dialog.

In past Mass Effect games you get a pretty broad variety of expressions and conversation directions which feels really good.. but in andromeda you sounds like this neutral puff.. I tried many of the aggressive options, my favorite was on comms you were talking to the Kett and there was an option with swear words and instead he was like.. hey, kind sir.. I don't like you.. lmao like WTF seriously.

The dialog is brutal and the worst part of it is you spend 60% of the game in empty maps exploring nothing or... talking to people, combat is like 30-40% or the actual gameplay.

Combat is ok, feels a bit rough at moments and you can easily get caught  in terrain or other bugs will encounter.. I went through a whole level where my health would not recharge... very weird.

Lastly, someone did not test the weapon development, I made a gun and said hey, I will put all ultra rare augments on the gun, one of them was the ricochet which broke the gun and made it useless.. I couldn't get it altered without deconstructing it, lost all the materials which took hours to collect.

I really did not enjoy this game.. but, the combat is just serviceable to have me finish it, I will beat the main missions but the rest is very forgettable.

A real 5 / 10 and would not recommend but still, just serviceable enough to be a bit of fun.

The dialog though, what a F*cking disappointment.
